articles.title: This sanctioned Russian stablecoin claims it processes billions, but blockchain analysts disagree
articles.snippet: A7A5 claims crypto data providers understate its trading activity, while blockchain analytics firms say the ruble-backed token's volumes have fallen sharply this year.

articles.title: South Africa proposes crypto tax guidance under existing framework
articles.snippet: South Africa’s tax authority proposed draft guidance clarifying how crypto assets are taxed under existing income and capital gains tax rules, seeking public input until Aug. 31.

articles.title: StanChart joins ESMA's first MiCA register update since deadline
articles.snippet: ESMA publishes its first post-deadline MiCA register update, adding 37 crypto-asset service providers, including Standard Chartered and FalconX.

articles.title: Fake Mac Clipboard App Delivers New Password-Stealing Malware
articles.snippet: A new Mac infostealer dubbed PamStealer impersonates the open-source Maccy clipboard manager to steal passwords and more.

articles.title: Russia Is Ready for 'Widespread Use' of Digital Ruble by September, Says Bank Governor
articles.snippet: Bank of Russia Governor Elvira Nabiullina said major banks and retailers are on track to begin accepting the digital ruble by September 1.
